title: Trade dress
slide_intent: Identify the composition of an identity as a subject in its own right. Readers may recognize a service through a combination of cues even without its logo.
strategic_value: Slack can name the broader family of visual and sensory elements it regards as distinctive.
demonstration: One short clause lists examples including color combinations, graphics, sounds, icons and typefaces. It occupies a small area beneath the title on an otherwise open page.
practical_value: Use the page to locate this edition’s treatment of combined identity cues when reviewing a third-party design.

content_islands.name: Clause under the heading
content_islands.spec: Align the Trade dress heading with the book’s left margin and rule. Place the single lettered paragraph beneath it in the narrow left column.
